page.overview:
What is Caed Dhu?

Caed Dhu (from Elder Speech: Black Forest or Black Grove) is a forest in Angren, on the right bank of the Yaruga, east to Red Port and west to the Klamat. It is also the location of a druids' circle.

In , Geralt's company wanted to visit the forest to search out the druids for information on Ciri's whereabouts.

While the druids originally lived in Caed Dhu, they were later forced to flee south to Loch Monduirn and, later, Caed Myrkvid.
